spots.name: Riehen
spots.summary: Riehen is a municipality in the canton of Basel-Stadt in Switzerland. Together with the city of Basel and Bettingen, Riehen is one of three municipalities in the canton.

spots.name: Basel Minster
spots.summary: Basel Minster is a religious building in the Swiss city of Basel, originally a Roman Catholic cathedral and today a Reformed Protestant church.

spots.name: Kunstmuseum Basel

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Kunstmuseum Basel houses the oldest public art collection in the world and is generally considered to be the most important museum of art in Switzerland. It is listed as a Swiss heritage site of national significance.

spots.name: Basel Town Hall
spots.summary: The Basel Town Hall is a 500-year-old building dominating the Marktplatz in Basel, Switzerland.

spots.name: Three Countries Bridge
spots.summary: The Three Countries Bridge is an arch bridge which crosses the Rhine between the commune of Huningue (France) and Weil am Rhein (Germany), within the Basel (Switzerland) metropolitan area. It is the world's longest single-span bridge dedicated exclusively to carrying pedestrians and cyclists.

spots.name: Basel SBB railway station
spots.summary: Basel SBB railway station is the central railway station in the city of Basel, Switzerland. Opened in 1854 but rebuilt in 1907, it is Europe's busiest international border station: owned by Swiss Federal Railways (SBB CFF FFS) and partly operated by France's SNCF.

spots.name: Basel Badischer Bahnhof
spots.summary: Basel Badischer Bahnhof is a railway station in the Swiss city of Basel 2 km south of the Germany–Switzerland border.

names.ja: バーゼル・バディッシャー駅

spots.name: Vitra Design Museum
spots.summary: The Vitra Design Museum is a privately owned museum for design in Weil am Rhein, Germany, near Basel, Switzerland. The museum building is by Frank Gehry.

names.ja: ヴィトラ・デザイン・ミュージアム

spots.name: Mittlere Brücke
spots.summary: The Middle Bridge is a historic bridge in the Swiss city of Basel. It is situated on the oldest existing bridge site across the Rhine, between Lake Constance and the North Sea. It also marks the boundary between the High Rhine and Upper Rhine sections of the river.

spots.name: Beyeler Foundation
spots.summary: The Beyeler Foundation or Fondation Beyeler, with its museum in Riehen, near Basel (Switzerland), owns and oversees the art collection of Hildy and Ernst Beyeler, which features modern and traditional art.

spots.name: Münchenstein
spots.summary: Münchenstein is a municipality in the district of Arlesheim in the canton of Basel-Landschaft in Switzerland.

names.ja: ミュンヘンシュタイン

spots.name: Muttenz
spots.summary: Muttenz is a municipality with a population of about 17,000 in the canton of Basel-Country in Switzerland. It is in the district of Arlesheim, next to the city of Basel.

spots.name: Walls of Basel
spots.summary: The Basel city walls are a complex of walls surrounding the central part of the Swiss city of Basel, only partially preserved today. The first city wall was completed around 1080 under bishop Burkhard von Fenis. A newer wall was constructed around 1230, which is known as the Inner Wall.

spots.name: Museum Tinguely

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Museum Tinguely is an art museum in Basel, Switzerland, devoted to the work of Swiss painter and sculptor Jean Tinguely (1925–1991). The building was designed by architect Mario Botta and opened in 1996 beside the Rhine.

photo.author: Alan Philip Müller from Milano, Italy

spots.name: Jewish Museum of Switzerland

hours.note: Closed Sat

spots.summary: The Jewish Museum of Switzerland in Basel provides an overview of the religious and everyday history of the Jews in Basel and Switzerland using objects of ritual, art and everyday culture from the Middle Ages to the present.

spots.name: Basel Historical Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Basel Historical Museum is one of the largest and most important museums of its kind in Switzerland and a heritage site of national significance. It opened in 1894. The museum is divided into three buildings within the city of Basel: the Barfüsserkirche, Haus zum Kirschgarten and Musikmuseum.

spots.name: Kunsthalle Basel

hours.note: Closed Mon, Wed, Fri, Sun

spots.summary: Kunsthalle Basel is a contemporary art gallery in Basel, Switzerland.

names.ja: バーゼル・クンストハレ

spots.name: Freie Strasse
spots.summary: Freie Strasse is the oldest shopping street in the city of Basel, Switzerland. It was already used as a transportation and trade route towards the west during the time of the Roman settlement in Augusta Raurica around 44 BC. Today, it is considered one of the most important shopping streets in the city.

spots.name: Gate of Spalen

spots.summary: The Basel city walls are a complex of walls surrounding the central part of the Swiss city of Basel, only partially preserved today. The first city wall was completed around 1080 under bishop Burkhard von Fenis. A newer wall was constructed around 1230, which is known as the Inner Wall.

spots.name: Elisabethenkirche
spots.summary: The Elisabethenkirche, or Offene Kirche Elisabethen, is a 19th-century church building in the centre of Basel, next to the Theater Basel, in Switzerland. It is a well detailed example of Swiss Gothic Revival style churches. It has a 72 metres (236 ft) tall bell tower and spire. The tower has internal stairs.

spots.name: Museum of Cultures

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Museum of Cultures in Basel is a Swiss museum of ethnography with large and important collections of artifacts, especially from Europe, the South Pacific, Mesoamerica, Tibet, and Bali. It is a Swiss heritage site of national significance.

names.es: Museo de las Culturas de Basilea

spots.name: Natural History Museum of Basel

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: Natural History Museum Basel is a natural history museum in Basel, Switzerland that houses wide-ranging collections focused on the fields of zoology, entomology, mineralogy, anthropology, osteology and paleontology. It has over 11 million objects.

names.es: Museo de Historia Natural de Basilea
names.it: Museo di scienze naturali di Basilea
names.ja: バーゼル自然史博物館

spots.name: Zoo Basel
spots.summary: Zoo Basel is a zoological garden in the city of Basel, Switzerland. Its official name is Zoologischer Garten Basel — or in English: Basel Zoological Garden. Basel residents affectionately call it Zolli.

spots.name: The Blue and The White House
spots.summary: The Blue and The White House are two town mansions in the city of Basel.
spots.wikipediaTitle: The Blue and The White House

spots.summary: Stadtcasino Basel is a concert hall in Basel, Switzerland.

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Antikenmuseum Basel und Sammlung Ludwig

hours.note: Closed Mon, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun

spots.summary: The Antikenmuseum Basel und Sammlung Ludwig is one of the many museums in the city of Basel, Switzerland and a heritage site of national significance. In 1961 the city of Basel decided to establish the museum to assemble the several antiquities in one place.

spots.name: Dollhouse Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Dollhouse Museum in Basel is the largest museum of its kind in Europe. Now known as the Spielzeug Welten Museum Basel. The museum is located at Barfüsserplatz in the city center.

names.fr: Musée de la Maison de Poupée
names.es: Museo de los Juguetes del Mundo

spots.name: Strassburger memorial
spots.summary: The Strassburger memorial is a monument in Basel established in memory of the help the civil population of Strassburg received from Switzerland during the Franco-Prussian war in 1870–1871. It was modeled by Frédéric Auguste Bartholdi and is located in a park across from the Basel SBB railway station.

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Pharmacy Museum of the University of Basel shows in its permanent collection the history of medicinal remedies and their preparation.

spots.summary: The Amerbach Cabinet was a collection of artifacts, paintings, libraries, assembled by members of the Amerbach family, most notably by the two law professors of the University of Basel, Bonifacius Amerbach and his son Basilius Amerbach the Younger.

spots.name: Swiss Architecture Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The S AM Swiss Architecture Museum is an architecture museum in Basel, Switzerland. Through its program of temporary exhibitions and events, it contributes to international debates on architecture and urban development as well as related socio-political aspects.

spots.name: St. Paul's Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: St. Paul's Church is a Reformed Church in Basel, Switzerland, part of the Evangelical-Reformed Church of the Canton Basel-Stadt. The church was constructed between May 1898 and November 1901 by Karl Moser (1860–1936) and Robert Curjel, and features a Neo-Romanesque architectural style.

spots.name: Music Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue

spots.summary: The Music Museum is located in Basel, Switzerland and houses the country's largest collection of musical instruments. The museum is one of three components of Historisches Museum Basel.

spots.name: Museum of Contemporary Art

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Museum of Contemporary Art in Basel (Switzerland) opened in 1980 as the first public museum in Europe exclusively dedicated to the production and practice of contemporary art from the 1960s to the present. It is a heritage site of national significance.

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Basel Paper Mill, also known as the Swiss Museum for Paper, Writing and Printing, is a museum located in Basel, Switzerland. The museum is primarily dedicated to the history and techniques of papermaking, and the art of book printing and writing in general.

spots.name: Haus zum Sessel
spots.summary: The Haus zum Sessel at Totengässlein 3 in Basel, Switzerland, was the site of the printing press of Johann Amerbach and his successor Johann Froben.

spots.name: Migros

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: in Bahnhof SBB, the Swiss train station, a store of the largest grocery store chain in Switzerland, provides sandwiches, tarts, fresh-baked bread, pizza, döner kebab, etc. at very reasonable prices, perfect for picnic lunches on outings. Similar: the Coop shop opposite the station (Centralbahnstrasse). Unlike all other grocery stores in the city, both are open late at night and on Sundays.

spots.name: Restaurant BaCell's/Kaffi Biozentrum

hours.note: Closed Sat, Sun

spots.summary: Opened in 2021 (along with the building) to cater for the students enrolled in biology, neuro and life sciences at Basel's university, this cafeteria is a great option for an affordable lunch – the futuristic interior, which is strikingly similar to that of the Roche corporate headquarter in Basel's East, is an added bonus.

spots.name: Café Spitz
spots.summary: Not simply a café - excellent seafood, with a nice terrace overlooking the Rhine. In the summer, there is a special menu with a variety of grilled fish. The outdoor seating area overlooking the Rhine has a reduced (and less expensive) menu.

spots.name: Mensa Universität Basel

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: One of the students cafeterias. Serves an inexpensive lunch menu not only to students from Monday to Friday. By no means 'gourmet' food, but you can eat your lunch on the terrace during warm weather.

spots.name: Lily's Maxim
spots.summary: Pan-Asian" bench table restaurant (like Wagamama but with more than noodles). Inexpensive good Asian food, outside terrace in summer. No reservations needed, and they do takeaway.

spots.name: Hirscheneck

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: Traditional left-wing, punk-run restaurant. You get a relatively cheap square meal. Always serves vegetarian and vegan food too. Breakfast on Sundays until 16:00.

spots.name: SAM'S Pizza Land

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The best American style eat out place. Has a take away counter which serves filling Turkish wraps and pizzas for around Fr. 8

spots.name: Brötlibar

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Brötli-Bar at the Stadthof Hotel, Barfüsserplatz, has a large selection of open sandwiches ("Brötli" to the Swiss).
